## Facts and statements

- [statement] TimeGPT-1 distinguishes zero-shot transfer without parameter retraining from fine-tuning on the new dataset starting from pretrained parameters. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2310.03589 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original Chronos paper scales and quantizes time-series values into a fixed vocabulary and trains transformer language models using cross-entropy. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2403.07815 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original Chronos study focuses on univariate, uniformly spaced time series. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2403.07815 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The Chronos paper treats task-specific covariate adaptors and stacking with other models as possible ways to incorporate exogenous information. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2403.07815 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] Chronos' authors note that rigorous leakage prevention would require zero-shot test datasets to start after the last observation in the pretraining and in-domain datasets. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2403.07815 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original Moirai paper uses Any-variate Attention to accept an arbitrary number of variates. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2402.02592 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original Moirai paper uses a mixture of parametric distributions to provide flexible predictive distributions. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2402.02592 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original Moirai paper reports training on LOTSA with over 27 billion observations across nine domains. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2402.02592 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original TimesFM paper pretrains a decoder-style attention model with input patching using real-world and synthetic time-series data. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2310.10688 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] The original TimesFM paper states that its model was not pretrained with covariates and proposes residual regression or fine-tuning as possible approaches to handling them. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2310.10688 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
- [statement] Meyer and colleagues' 2026 benchmark analysis identifies both reused train/test samples and temporally overlapping correlated series as potential sources of overly optimistic foundation-model evaluation. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2510.13654v2 · keywords: foundation models TimeGPT Chronos Moirai TimesFM
